items.title: SoFi’s Personal Loans Carry a 12.9% Coupon. A “10% card rate cap” Would Undercut Them
items.why: A card rate cap could push borrowers toward installment loans. Model how much card balance would migrate to personal loan products.
items.summary_ai: Analysis argues a proposed 10% credit card rate cap would undercut SoFi's personal loan pricing at a 12.9% coupon.
items.take: A card rate cap could push borrowers toward installment loans. Model how much card balance would migrate to personal loan products.
